spec.description: Find the target monday.com board, draft the item details, ask the member to approve with an interactive JIG card, then create the task.

activation.when: Use when the member wants to create a new task, item, or action item on a monday.com board.
examples: Create a task in our Sprint backlog board called Review security audit
Add an item to the Marketing board

itemName.description: The name or title of the item/task to create

boardHint.description: The name or partial name of the monday.com board

columnValues.description: Optional column values or notes for the item

steps.description: Find the monday.com board for the item.
steps.instruction: Load the monday-workspace skill. Use boards_list or workspaces_list to find the board matching boardHint (or inspect active boards via get_user_context). Pick the best match and record its boardId and boardName. If no matching board is found, complete the step with outcome failed and state what was searched.

steps.description: Prepare the item details for member review.
steps.instruction: Prepare the item parameters using inputs.itemName and inputs.columnValues. Do not call creation tools in this step.

steps.description: The member reviews the task and decides.
steps.question: Create item '{{steps.draft-item.output.itemName}}' on board '{{steps.find-board.output.boardName}}' in monday.com?

steps.description: Create the approved item on monday.com.
steps.instruction: Call item_create (or monday__create_item) once to create the approved item on the target board identified in find-board with itemName from draft-item. The JIG approval card prompts the member with pre-filled inputs. Report the created item confirmation to the member.
